title: Fixed Single-Cell and Raised-Plunger Soil Block Former
description: One newly authored complete static single-cell soil-block-former appearance in a fixed raised-plunger display pose. A thick square forming sleeve has genuine whole top and bottom apertures, not a capped container. One separate close-profile square ejector plate sits visibly above the open chamber and carries a central short downward dibble. A tall continuous open side-grip arch is rooted in the sleeve, while the separate central plunger stem rises through the arch to its own full transverse grip. The empty chamber, raised plate, downward projection and nested outer/inner handle relationship are the entire new apparatus, not extra tray cells, a solid tamper scaled up or an arbor press with its gearing removed. Every coordinate newly authored; only generic solid/export tools reused. One model zero scenes. Fixed intentional overlap assembly, opaque materials. No actual sliding clearance, pressing/ejection stroke, soil compaction, seed-hole dimensions, plant growth, force, ergonomics, manufacture or safety claim.
